source_basis: Public evidence and observed V13 execution failures; human-authored development-exposed reference, not learned Ours.

skill.title: share_difference
skill.goal: Difference of shares
skill.guidance: For two categories sharing one total: (first-second)/total. A decimal answer keeps that fraction; percent multiplies by 100 once. Do not confuse this with relative growth over the second category.

skill.title: decimal_scale
skill.goal: Decimal output scale
skill.guidance: A decimal ratio is the fraction, not the percentage number: 25%=0.25. Preserve the unrounded fraction; round only after the requested scale is fixed.

skill.title: polynomial_fit
skill.goal: Complete source series before polynomial forecasting
skill.guidance: Fit only the specified observations with an intercept; keep the target actual outside the fit. Use all required months. A polynomial of degree d needs at least d+1 distinct x values.

skill.title: difference_value
skill.goal: Source-bound subtraction
skill.guidance: Subtract matching categories and units: signed change is new minus old; absolute difference takes abs only when requested.

skill.title: rolling_range
skill.goal: Rolling statistic over the full requested scope
skill.guidance: Keep months in order and years in separate groups. Compute each full rolling window, then pooled max minus min across the requested groups. Do not report a min-to-max interval.

skill.title: normalized_midpoint
skill.goal: Submit a midpoint-normalized decimal
skill.guidance: Midpoint-normalized difference is abs(b-a)/((abs(a)+abs(b))/2). Keep the decimal fraction unless a percent conversion is explicitly requested.

skill.title: compound_growth
skill.goal: Source-bound compound growth and final percent display
skill.guidance: CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed_years)-1. Count intervals, not rows. Percent per year means multiply by 100 once and follow the requested final display; do not round endpoints.

skill.title: annual_log
skill.goal: Source-bound annual log growth
skill.guidance: Continuous relative change is ln(end/start). Divide by elapsed years only for an annualized rate; otherwise use one interval. It is not an absolute currency difference.

skill.title: absolute_deviation
skill.goal: Absolute deviation from the stated benchmark
skill.guidance: Average absolute deviation from a benchmark is mean(abs(value-benchmark)); retain all requested dates. Percentage-point inputs stay at that magnitude; a unit of measure need not be a suffix.

skill.title: dispersion
skill.goal: Select the statistical population before calculation
skill.guidance: For all stated years use population divisor n. Use n-1 only for an explicitly requested sample estimate. Do not change the convention after computing.

skill.title: regression_coordinates
skill.goal: Source-bound linear fit and signed forecast error
skill.guidance: Fit the requested years only, in the stated t coordinates. Keep forecast_x and its actual value outside fitting periods. Preserve the requested forecast-minus-actual sign.

skill.title: paired_series
skill.goal: Evidence-backed paired series
skill.guidance: Pair both observed series by the same period and adjustment basis. Do not fill a missing external series from memory. A correlation needs both actual series.

skill.title: series_scope
skill.goal: Mean over exactly the requested periods
skill.guidance: Use exactly the requested periods and category for a mean. Preserve blank columns; exclude adjacent totals, duplicated months and forecast observations.

skill.title: log_trim
skill.goal: Logarithm and trimming order
skill.guidance: Apply the requested logarithm first, sort, remove floor(n*proportion) values per tail, then average the retained values. Take the total column, not a financing component.

skill.title: median_deviation
skill.goal: Deviation from median
skill.guidance: Compute the median of the complete selected series, then average absolute distances from that median. Verify revisions before fixing the series.

skill.title: theil
skill.goal: Theil T definition
skill.guidance: For positive observations, Theil T is mean((x/mean(x))*ln(x/mean(x))). Round the computed result normally; do not truncate to fit an expected-looking value.

skill.title: revision_basis
skill.goal: Choose the matching revision before binding cells
skill.guidance: Honor an explicit as-of release. Otherwise compare already supplied same-definition historical revisions before binding the value. Once all required periods and headers are verified, compute; do not expand to every bulletin merely because years repeat.

skill.title: total_scope
skill.goal: Totals across continued panels
skill.guidance: A total may be in the continued panel; do not substitute its largest component. Reporting in dollars does not restrict a category to dollar-denominated assets.

skill.title: table_groups
skill.goal: Faithful cells in grouped tables
skill.guidance: Count blank cells as columns. Read the full year/category header above a repeated month. Bind the exact row in that group, not the first matching month elsewhere.

skill.title: answer_only
skill.goal: Submit the requested final fields without rewriting correct results
skill.guidance: Submit only the requested final answer fields, never reasoning, labels, intermediate operands or alternative answers. Default numeric output is the number alone: asking what percent does not itself request a % suffix. An explicit template, literal % example, requested suffix or list takes priority. Rounding precision alone does not require padding zeros; omit redundant decimal zeros unless a fixed-width format is explicit. Preserve sign and scale. Submit the final acquired calculation without recomputing it in prose.

skill.title: arc_change
skill.goal: Distinguish arc change from ordinary growth
skill.guidance: Arc or symmetric percentage change uses (new-old)/((old+new)/2), not (new-old)/old. Take abs only if requested; convert the fraction to percent only when requested, multiplying by 100 once. This endpoint change is not annualized and does not divide by the number of years. If an elasticity specifies a second changing quantity, divide by that quantity's midpoint change. Compute with unrounded operands and format only at submission.

skill.title: percent_difference
skill.goal: Distinguish symmetric percent difference from directional growth
skill.guidance: An absolute percent difference between two amounts uses abs(b-a)/((a+b)/2)*100 when no reference baseline is specified. A percent change relative to a named baseline instead divides by that baseline. Do not substitute one formula for the other. Keep source units equal, calculate at full precision, then round and submit only the requested result.

skill.title: median_absolute_deviation
skill.goal: Use the median rather than mean for explicitly defined MAD
skill.guidance: When MAD is defined as median absolute deviation, first m=median(values), then MAD=median(abs(x-m)). It is not mean(abs(x-m)). Keep the exact requested observation periods, units and revisions; calculate any subsequent difference against the named benchmark only after MAD is computed.

skill.title: table_block_binding
skill.goal: Keep extracted observations inside their named table and row type
skill.guidance: Bind each value to table title, row label, full column header, unit and period. End extraction at the next table heading. Never scan a fixed character chunk across tables or let another same-year row overwrite an annual total. Separate annual, monthly, fiscal-to-date and estimate rows. Where receipts/outlays are present, check total surplus=total receipts-total outlays before fitting.

skill.title: log_growth_cv
skill.goal: Calculate coefficient of variation of log growth rates
skill.guidance: For levels x[0..n], form consecutive g[i]=ln(x[i+1]/x[i]); CV=population_std(g)/mean(g) when population is requested. Compute both series at full precision, then abs(CV1-CV2); round once. Use Python for the complete operation, especially when mean growth is near zero. Failed execution supplies no computed value.

applicability.when: coefficient of variation.*log growth|growth-based Debt Sustainability

skill.title: complete_monthly_series
skill.goal: Compute a complete monthly mean or argmax
skill.guidance: Build explicit (year,month,series1,series2) records from the table's year groups. Require exactly one record for every requested month before computing spread=series1-series2. Use Python for mean or argmax over all records; do not average a convenient panel or estimate from visual peaks. Keep the winning year/month with argmax, then apply any requested encoding arithmetically.

skill.title: month_encoding
skill.goal: Apply a requested arithmetic date encoding
skill.guidance: After finding the requested month and year, compute the stated arithmetic expression explicitly. For month*100+year, do that addition; do not concatenate YYYYMM or use year*100+month. Submit the calculated integer only.

skill.title: category_aggregation
skill.goal: Count named categories after merging their subcolumns
skill.guidance: The question's named categories are the counting units. Combine life and fire/casualty insurance into insurance companies, and general plus pension funds into state/local governments when those are the named parent categories. Sum all in-scope instrument rows per category before applying the threshold. Do not count total outstanding or all-other-investors as a requested category.

skill.title: ffo_public_layout
skill.goal: Recognize Treasury FFO-1 annual totals
skill.guidance: FFO-1 fact card: receipts, outlays and surplus/deficit each have total/on-budget/off-budget columns. Annual fiscal-year rows and later fiscal-to-date/monthly rows can repeat the same year. Select the total surplus/deficit of the annual row, inside FFO-1; retain its header and row evidence. A repeated year later in the page is not automatically a revised annual value.
skill.source_basis: Public FFO-1 headers and row types in the supplied Treasury Bulletin pages; no target answers.

skill.title: ay1_public_layout
skill.goal: Recognize repeated year panels in the bond yield table
skill.guidance: AY-1 fact card: monthly rows repeat Jan-Dec in stacked year bands and horizontal groups of Treasury/Aa-corporate/municipal columns. OCR may omit the year labels. Verify group years using visible labels and dated weekly overlap; the partially populated last band is not a complete earlier year. Keep blank cells and footnote markers from shifting numeric columns.
skill.source_basis: Public AY-1 table headers, repeated Jan-Dec bands and weekly-date overlap in supplied pages; no target answers.

entry_constraints.description: Caller explicitly declares source and output scales

program.title: Submit an acquired final scalar with explicit scale and requested display

fixed_decimals.description: True only when an exact fixed-width decimal format is requested; default false removes redundant fractional zeros after rounding.

implementation.goal: Submit the requested final fields without rewriting correct results

profiles.manual: Short operation/fact AtomicSkills plus optional scalar submission
